apple.name: Island Transport Academy
apple.subtitle: Drive, ride and fly in Taiwan
apple.promotionalText: Explore Taiwan-inspired scenery with cars, trains and planes. Big buttons and Traditional Chinese guidance help families begin a journey and arrive together.
apple.description:
Cars, trains or planes: where shall we go today?

Island Transport Academy is a 3D transport game for families with children ages 3 to 5. The interface and guidance are in Traditional Chinese. Big buttons break each journey into simple actions, with original scenery inspired by Taiwan.

Three vehicles in one place
CARS: Choose a vehicle and route. Use touch steering, throttle and brakes. Compatible devices can also use optional tilt steering.
TRAINS: Prepare to depart, watch signals, brake early, stop at a station and open the doors. Optional stopping help controls traction and brakes through the simulation rather than moving the train instantly.
PLANES: Take off, follow navigation rings, collect stars, deliver mail, see the sights and return to the airport. Tap left, right or the main action button.

Play and learn together
Preschool controls keep each action clear. Parents can open the full controls and instruments to explore speed, direction, inertia, train braking and aircraft attitude. Blender vehicle and cockpit models use image textures.

Play offline
Game content is installed with the app. No login is required. Traditional Chinese voice guidance uses a suitable voice already installed on the device. If one is unavailable, full on-screen guidance remains available. Preferences and play records stay in local app storage. Parents can mute sound or choose a lower graphics setting.

The initial release is free, with no ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions or gameplay analytics SDK. This is a family game with simplified operation lessons, not a real-world driving qualification. Original code and Blender assets are open source under the MIT license.
apple.releaseNotes: First native release: cars, trains and planes in one app, preschool buttons, local Traditional Chinese voice guidance and bundled offline 3D gameplay.

Cars, trains or planes: where shall we go today?

Island Transport Academy is a 3D transport game for families with children ages 3 to 5. Its interface and guidance are in Traditional Chinese. Big buttons and original Taiwan-inspired scenery turn a journey into simple actions.

CARS: Choose a vehicle and route, then use touch steering, throttle and brakes. Compatible devices offer optional tilt steering.
TRAINS: Prepare to depart, watch signals, brake early, stop and open the doors for passengers. Optional stopping help adjusts real simulated traction and braking.
PLANES: Take off, navigate, collect stars, deliver mail, see the sights and return to the airport. Tap left, right or the main action button.

Parents can open full controls and instruments to explore speed, direction, inertia and aircraft attitude. Vehicle and cockpit models are created in Blender with image textures.

Game content is bundled with the app for offline play, without an account. Voice guidance uses a suitable Traditional Chinese voice already installed on the device. Full on-screen guidance works when no local voice is available. Preferences and play records are stored locally.

The initial release is free, with no ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions or gameplay analytics SDK. This is a family game with simplified operation lessons, not a real-world driving qualification. Original code and Blender assets are open source under the MIT license.
